sloka: रक्तकण्ठगुणो धीरो महापर्वतसन्निभः।कालः कालमहावक्त्रो मेघस्थ इव भास्करः ।। ६.७१.२२ ।।
transliteration: raktakaṇṭhaguṇo dhīro mahāparvatasannibhaḥ।kālaḥ kālamahāvaktro meghastha iva bhāskaraḥ ।। 6.71.22 ।।

translations.english: "Wearing red garland s round the neck, brave, like a mountain in form, dark with large mouth, like death, like sun veiled by clouds he seems."
